newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-June fertiliser output 13.407 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-June fertiliser output 13.407 mln T.

text.p: China produced 13.407 million tonnes of fertiliser in the first half, up 4.7 percent from the year-ago period, the Economic Daily said on Friday.
Stockpiles held by fertiliser firms increased sharply in the first half, forcing more firms to operate below capacity, the newspaper said.
A total of 5.99 billion yuan ($721 million) of funds were tied up in stockpiles, up 130 percent from the year-ago, it said.
Fertiliser sales stagnated and prices declined by about 20 percent year-on-year, falling below production costs in some areas, it said.
Fertiliser firms also faced a surge in bad debts, the newspaper said. Bad debts totalled 9.46 billion yuan in the first half, up 80.2 percent year-on-year. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
